description: The Prüfer code of a tree on vertices 1..n. Edges are a flat list of pairs. The path 1-2-3-4 gives 2,3. The star with center 1 and leaves 2,3,4 gives 1,1. Two vertices give an empty code. Vertices run from 1 to 30. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/prufer-encode
